english.notes:
(i) This offence was inserted by section 81 of the Serious Crime Act 2007.
(ii) Until the commencement of section 281(5) of the Criminal Justice Act 2003 the reference to 51 weeks in the penalty is to be read as a reference to 6 months.

other.penalty:
Summary: 51 weeks imprisonment and / or a fine not exceeding level 5 on the standard scale.

Note:
Until the commencement of section 281(5) of the Criminal Justice Act 2003 the reference to 51 weeks is to be read as a reference to 6 months.

Time limit for prosecutions:
6 months

On the 12th March 2015 the limit on fines imposed by a Magistrates’ court was removed – as such, the potential fine on summary conviction in relation to an offence committed after this date is unlimited.
